availability.qc: library-size+mito proxy (no singlet/demuxlet field in public schema)
availability.control_like_def: treated cell response score <= matched-DMSO Xth pct (primary 95; 90/99 sensitivity)
availability.uncertainty: cell-sampling bootstrap only (single plate = no biological-replicate CI)

control_like_definition: treated cell response score <= matched-DMSO Xth percentile (primary X=95); NOT called resistant
uncertainty_note: cell-sampling bootstrap CI only — single plate, NOT biological-replicate uncertainty
